description: This Java source file implements a Renderer class for rendering a textured triangle using OpenGL ES in an Android application. It sets up OpenGL ES state, loads a texture from resources, and draws a rotating triangle with texture mapping.

classes.name: TriangleRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for rendering a textured triangle with rotation and texture loading in OpenGL ES on Android.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: A helper class that initializes vertex, texture coordinate, and index buffers to draw a textured triangle.

methods.name: TriangleRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with application context and creates a Triangle instance.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL ES state, creates and binds a texture from resource when the surface is created.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears the buffers, sets up camera view, binds texture, applies rotation based on system time, and draws the triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when surface dimensions change.

methods.name: Triangle
methods.description: Constructs buffers for vertices, textures, and indices to represent a triangle shape for rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the triangle, setting vertex pointers, texture coordinates, and issuing draw commands.
